basics.name: Kevin James
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer | Lead Architect | Remote (CA/PT)
basics.summary: Staff Engineer and Architect with 14+ years designing realtime, distributed systems for AI. Led multiple teams and acted as system architect responsible for all Voice AI systems handling 10B+ minutes per day peaking at 100M+ concurrent calls. Flagship work in building ASR and NLP systems and infrastructure on-par with Google for quality and performance at 1/100th of the inference cost. Multiple patents for AI architecture and infrastructure scaling and self-healing.

work.name: Dialpad
highlights: Redesigned the realtime voice pipeline for self-healing and autoscaling, raising availability from 98% to 99.995% and cutting outage recovery from ~6 hours to 12 minutes across 100M+ concurrent calls.
Architected and led the Voice AI platform serving 10B+ minutes/day at peaks of 100M+ concurrent calls, owning system design across ASR, NLP, and realtime telephony infrastructure.
Delivered ASR and NLP systems matching Google's quality and performance at ~1/100th of the inference cost, via custom infrastructure and compute optimization.

Grew the Voice AI organization from a 2-engineer team into 4 sub-teams of 6+ engineers each, personally mentoring the majority of the org - driving 9 internal promotions and 95%+ retention - and established a culture of retrospectives, fireside deep-dives, and cross-team knowledge sharing.

Led dozens of high-impact architectural migrations across hundreds of engineers and scientists - including AWS→GCP, Python 2→3, pip→Poetry, task queues/Redis Streams→Pub/Sub, and Pusher→Ably - reducing combined infrastructure spend by >90% while maintaining 99.99% availability throughout.

Owned technical roadmap integration across 8 product and platform teams, achieving 95% on-time delivery on major initiatives while driving cross-department stakeholder alignment and company-wide system design standards.
